name: receipts-compliance-mcp-mit
description: Verify signed AI-agent receipt bundles and build regulator-ready compliance reports from them, offline.
long_description: Runs locally. Checks a signed receipt bundle manifest against an Ed25519 public key, then turns a set of receipts into auditor-ready Markdown: EU AI Act Annex IV, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894, NIST AI RMF, SOC 2, GDPR DPIA and Records of Processing, HIPAA Security Rule, EU Cyber Resilience Act, and an audit against a signed AI constitution. Receipts are never uploaded. Narrative sections that need operator input are left as clearly marked stubs.

tools.name: verify_manifest
tools.description: Verify a signed receipt bundle manifest against an Ed25519 public key.

tools.name: build_annex_iv
tools.description: EU AI Act Annex IV technical documentation from receipts.

tools.name: build_soc2_evidence
tools.description: SOC 2 Trust Service Criteria evidence binder.

tools.name: build_gdpr_dpia
tools.description: GDPR Article 35 DPIA and Article 30 Records of Processing.

tools.name: build_eu_cra

tools.name: build_constitution_audit
tools.description: Audit a receipt set against a signed AI constitution.

tools.description: Create a constitution document that receipts can be audited against.
